scripts.migrate:make: npm run knex -- migrate:make -x ts --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:local: npm run knex -- migrate:latest --env local --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:docker: npm run knex -- migrate:latest --env docker --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:staging: npm run knex -- migrate:latest --env staging --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:prod: npm run knex -- migrate:latest --env production --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:rollback: npm run knex -- migrate:rollback --step=1 --env local --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:rollback:docker: npm run knex -- migrate:rollback --step=1 --env docker --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:rollback:all: npm run knex -- migrate:rollback --all --env local --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:rollback:docker:all: npm run knex -- migrate:rollback --all --env docker --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.setup:local: npm run migrate:local && npm run seed:demo
scripts.setup:docker: npm run migrate:docker && npm run seed:docker
scripts.reset:db: NODE_ENV=local tsx scripts/resetDatabase.ts && npm run migrate:local && npm run seed:demo
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org accountable-0p --project node-express . && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org accountable-0p --project node-express .
